title: Prompt retype, send, streamed answer, mark close
summary: A lone prompt bar on light grey: one question is typed and erased, a second is typed and sent with a cursor click, the view drops to a chat thread where a long answer streams and scrolls, then the brand mark holds.
use_when: An AI writing or chat product that wants a 10 s silent loop of ask, answer, mark
Showing that the assistant writes long-form output fast
A minimal, monochrome brand that should feel like a native chat UI
A feed teaser where the prompt itself is the hook

look.type_style: regular grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking; prompt text ~5 % H in the close bar view, answer body ~3 % H in the thread view, heading same weight as body

structure.shot: centred pill prompt bar with plus button and dark round send button; a 4-word question types in, then is erased
structure.camera: push-in 1.00 -> ~1.25 by 1.00 s (bar width 225 -> 282 px in sheet cells), springs.cameraIn, overshoot not measurable; settles ~4 % back
structure.motion: question typed in ~15 fr (done by 0.50 s, ±0.25 s); held ~8 fr; backspaced to empty by 1.27 s (~15 fr, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: same bar: a 4-word writing request types in; pointer cursor enters bottom right, glides to the send button and clicks
structure.camera: drift: bar holds near 1.25, eases back ~10 % between 2.50 and 2.77 s (bar width 282 -> 255 px)
structure.motion: request typed 1.50 -> 2.00 s (~15 fr, ±0.25 s); cursor visible from 1.77 s, reaches send at 2.27 s on springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); click at 2.50 s with springs.click squash; bar fades out by 3.00 s

structure.shot: empty light grey frame, then the sent request appears as a small right-aligned bubble near the top of a chat thread view
structure.camera: static (thread view, scale ~0.4 of the bar view)
structure.motion: bubble fades in 3.27 -> 3.50 s, easings.outQuint ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: answer streams under the bubble: a 2-word heading, then a long first paragraph, narrow left column
structure.motion: stream ~2 lines per 0.25 s (~8 lines/s, about 24 words/s), constant rate, easings.linear; each chunk fades in (fade not measurable at ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: second heading and paragraph stream in; the thread scrolls up so the stream bottom stays in view, bubble leaves the top
structure.camera: dolly up: 60 px/s at 5-6 s, 332 px/s at 6-7 s, 11 px/s at 7-8 s (1920-wide), easings.inOutSine
structure.motion: stream continues at the same rate; scroll follows the text bottom

structure.shot: answer finishes; a short follow-up request bubble appears under it, the thread scrolls it up, then everything fades to the bare background
structure.camera: dolly up ~60 % of frame height between 7.77 and 8.00 s, easings.outExpo (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: follow-up bubble fades in by 7.50 s; thread fades out by 8.27 s (~8 fr, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: monochrome brand mark centred on the grey background, about 15 % of frame height, held to the end
structure.motion: mark appears by 8.50 s (entrance under 8 fr, ±0.25 s), holds 45 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: bg (light grey), fg, muted, logo mark
params.content.decoy: first prompt that is typed then erased, about 4 words
params.content.prompt: the real request that gets sent, about 4 words
params.content.answer: streamed answer: a short heading and 2 paragraphs of about 60-80 words
params.timing.streamWps: answer stream rate in words per second (reference ~24)

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Zero detected cuts: the bar-to-thread and thread-to-mark changes are fades through the bare background (proposed term fade-through-bg; tagged blur-dissolve as nearest id, no blur measurable). Prompt erase (backspace) is the hook. Two scales: close bar view, then a thread view at ~0.4 scale. The stream is fast (~24 words/s) so the scroll, not the reading, carries rows 4-6. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured; the reference is silent.
